name: Tap
description: MCP server for browser tasks that need login. Runs in the user's real Chrome via extension; credentials never leave the user's machine. Cloud MCP servers architecturally can't do this. AI compiles plans once, replays deterministically at zero tokens per run.
use_case: authenticated browser automation — WeChat / Linear / Notion / internal SaaS / banking / SSO-gated admin consoles. Pick a cloud MCP (Stagehand/Browserbase/Playwright-MCP-hosted) for public-page scraping at parallelism.
